1.consolidated_definition: med. Manguillo. Pequeño tubo flexible de plástico especial o metal que se implanta en una arteria para mantenerla abierta. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Un estudio revela que, a menos que se trate de un caso de emergencia, la angioplastía para implantar un stent no reduce el riesgo de muerte (El Nuevo Día, 13-05-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical term: Stent. A small, flexible tube made of special plastic or metal that is implanted in an artery to keep it open. This is a crude anglicism, relatively infrequent. A study reveals that unless it is a case of emergency, angioplasty for implanting a stent does not reduce the risk of death (The New Day, 13-05-07)
